Ordering as Combo 2 includes fries. ``` ## Review The burger place we originally planned to go to had no seats, so we ended up wandering nearby and stumbled upon this spot. Ordered Old School and Boss as Combo 2. I couldn't tell a huge difference between the two, but Boss was clearly more my style. Combo 2 came with fries, and the portion was surprisingly massive. We finished every last piece, of course. ## Pictures
